claims: Kara Lawson is the head coach of the Duke University women’s basketball team.
Kara Lawson has held the position of head coach of the Duke University women’s basketball team since 2020.
Kara Lawson led the Blue Devils to the 2025-26 ACC Regular Season Championship.
Kara Lawson is recognized as the only active Division I women's basketball coach to have played in a Final Four, won a WNBA championship, and earned an Olympic gold medal.
